accounts_validity_order.name: accounts_validity_order
accounts_validity_order.value: "accounts"."valid_until" is null or "accounts"."valid_from" is null or "accounts"."valid_until" >= "accounts"."valid_from"

profiles_expiry_after_sale.name: profiles_expiry_after_sale
profiles_expiry_after_sale.value: "profiles"."sale_date" is null or "profiles"."expiration_date" is null or "profiles"."expiration_date" >= "profiles"."sale_date"

profiles_held_requires_customer.name: profiles_held_requires_customer
profiles_held_requires_customer.value:
("profiles"."status" in ('sold', 'reserved', 'expiring_soon') and "profiles"."customer_id" is not null)
          or ("profiles"."status" = 'available' and "profiles"."customer_id" is null)
          or "profiles"."status" = 'expired'

issues_resolved_has_note.name: issues_resolved_has_note
issues_resolved_has_note.value:
"issues"."status" <> 'resolved'
          or ("issues"."resolution_note" is not null and "issues"."resolved_at" is not null and "issues"."resolved_by" is not null)

backups_completed_has_artifact.name: backups_completed_has_artifact
backups_completed_has_artifact.value:
"backups"."status" not in ('completed', 'verified')
          or ("backups"."filename" is not null and "backups"."checksum" is not null and "backups"."completed_at" is not null)
